premise_that_was_wrong: The rungs above contract_compiled were reported as unreachable because each needs an actor, an authority or money. All three existed and none were pointed at the one interaction the estate has actually performed.

the_read.actor: BonfyreProject/1.0, the identity the source was shown at request time
the_read.authority: the source's own robots.txt. The institution granted itself nothing; the server published a standing rule and the rule allowed the path
the_read.note: The DESCRIBE relation reports authority_required false, so --grant-authority is not passed and cannot be the reason anything closes.

defect_fixed_before_enacting.was: the driver took the first shape-derived facet, compiling AUTHENTICATE against 1041 sources nobody authenticated to and PUBLISH against sources whose own receipts state that robots allowing a read is not a licence to republish
defect_fixed_before_enacting.now: 2337 contracts, 100 percent DESCRIBE, the relation actually performed

gates_each_enactment_passed: robots returned a rule and the rule allowed this path
the retained bytes still hash to the digest the receipt recorded

observed_phenotype_tier.finding: 502 syndication feeds were typed DATASET and MEDIA_ASSET and only 49 as EVENT, because phenotype was derived from descriptions and a feed's description does not say feed. Its bytes do.
observed_phenotype_tier.change: a third derivation tier, observed, which outranks shape and domain because it rests on what the source actually served

economic.finding: the earlier reading -- a quote needs a price from a carrier this estate does not hold -- was true of the carriers and false of the sources
economic.note: A quote is rung one of five. committed, paid, settled and reconciled all move money and remain unreached, which is a decision rather than a limitation.

does_not_establish: a licence to republish or derive from anything read
authority over anything else these sources offer
that the sources agree their obligations were discharged
an intention to pay any quoted price, or that any price is fair
